name: Warp and resample surface label ROIs to volume (Freesurfer space)
summary: Resamples template-surface labels to a subject's FreeSurfer surfaces and maps them into ribbon-constrained volume ROIs with Connectome Workbench 1.5.0.
description: Converts the template and subject surfaces to GIFTI, resamples each label from the template sphere to the subject sphere (wb_command -label-resample, ADAP_BARY_AREA) and maps it into the subject's FreeSurfer volume with ribbon-constrained label-to-volume mapping, writing one ROI volume per hemisphere. Use it to bring atlas labels defined on fsaverage-like surfaces into a subject's anatomical space. An existing ROIs datatype can be passed so the new ROIs are added to it.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output of the target subject.
Template (for example fsaverage) surfaces for left and right hemispheres on which the labels are defined.
inputs.requirements: Must include ?h.sphere.reg.gii; the App exits otherwise.

inputs.description: Left and right GIFTI label files on the template surfaces, with a label.json key.
This is useful if you want to copy the new files into a pre-existing rois datatype

outputs.description: Volume ROIs of the resampled labels in FreeSurfer subject space.
Labels resampled to the subject's native surfaces (left.gii, right.gii) and label.json.
Subject pial, white, inflated and sphere.reg surfaces in GIFTI format.

parameters.description:
This may be an optional parameter for your data. Sometimes the correspondence between freesurfer volume and surface space is off. This will apply a fix in those situations if true. 

if the final ROIs don't properly align, try rerunning and setting this to true

failure_modes.message: surface vertices input is missing sphere.reg. this is required to map between the template and subject spaces. please check and reupload if necessary
failure_modes.fix: Provide template surfaces that include sphere.reg.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivative files
failure_modes.fix: Check the log; the resampled label files were not produced.
Provide a FreeSurfer license in the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable.
